articles.title: Quote of the day by Epicurus: ‘It is folly for a man to pray to the gods for that which he...’ – Greek philosopher reminds us that true power begins with self-reliance
articles.description: Ancient Greek philosopher Epicurus emphasized personal responsibility over divine intervention. He taught that genuine happiness stems from simple living and rational thought. His philosophy encourages focusing on controllable actions rather than external forces. This ancient wisdom remains relevant for modern personal development and resilience. Taking action is the essential bridge between aspirations and achievements.
